Tracing Caravaggio

Artwork Sources

The paintings behind the exhibition, and the sources of their digital reproductions.

All 25 paintings are by Michelangelo Merisi da Caravaggio. Their original works are in the public domain. The source pages below describe the individual reproductions and any regional or license conditions. Image preparation does not imply endorsement by the original photographers or institutions.

Boy with a Basket of Fruit

Caravaggio · c. 1593–1595

Photograph: Architas (2018). The source lists CC BY-SA 4.0 and notes the public-domain status of faithful reproductions of two-dimensional public-domain works in the United States. Colors adjusted for this exhibition; display and export copies may be resized or compressed.
